info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Stream Upstreams API
NGINX Return Status of All Stream Upstream Server Groups

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of upstream server groups will be output. If the “<literal>fields</literal>” value is empty, only names of upstreams will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of each stream upstream server group and its servers.

info.name: NGINX Return Status of a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of a stream upstream server group.

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of the upstream server group will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of a particular stream upstream server group and its servers.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics of a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of a stream upstream server group.

items.docs: Resets the statistics for each upstream server in an upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Return Configuration of All Servers in a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an upstream server group.

items.docs: Returns configuration of each server in a particular stream upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Add a Server to a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an upstream server group.

items.docs: Adds a new server to a stream upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Return Configuration of a Server in a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Returns configuration of a particular server in the stream upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Modify a Server in a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Modifies settings of a particular server in a stream upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Remove a Server from a Stream Upstream Server Group

params.name: streamUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Removes a server from a stream server group.
